text: The 1985 St. Louis mayoral election took place on April 2, 1985, to select the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri, and resulted in Vincent C. Schoemehl being re-elected for a second term. The election was preceded by party primaries held on March 5. Vincent C. Schoemehl is a member of the Democratic Party. This Missouri elections-related article is a stub.
